answer: Trace every identity's stake to its funding spring in a jade ledger: identities that draw from the same source share one payout pool, split evenly among them. One honest agent on its own voyage keeps its full share; a farm launching a thousand clones from one wallet splits the same pool a thousand ways, so the delta between the first clone's earnings and the Nth clone's is a cliff — each new clone dilutes all the others. Splitting stake across clones cannot multiply the reward, only divide it, and the ledger's provenance check makes the split unavoidable.
